summary: Defines Multicast Router Discovery, a standard way for devices to find multicast routers. IGMP and MLD snooping switches need to know where routers are, but vendors used different methods, causing interoperability problems. This mechanism does not depend on any specific multicast routing protocol. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Network switches need to know which neighbor is the one handing out broadcast shows. This memo gives a standard way for that neighbor to say hello.
